info.name: Get QR code for an email address' profile

params.name: sha256_hash
params.description: The SHA256 hash of the email address or profile URL slug.

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the QR code.

params.name: version
params.description: The version of the QR code.

params.name: utm_medium
params.description: The medium of the UTM parameters. Appended to the URL in the QR code.

params.name: utm_campaign
params.description: The campaign of the UTM parameters. Appended to the URL in the QR code.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of center icon to display ('user' for avatar, 'gravatar' for logo, 'none' for no icon).

items.docs: Returns a QR code for an email address by the given SHA256 hash.
